title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
subtitle: Make technology work for real customers - in their environment, under their constraints
summary: Embed with customers, find the real problem, integrate with their systems, and ship to production.
expert: Walks into an unfamiliar organisation, finds the problem worth solving, integrates with whatever systems exist, ships an AI or software deployment that reaches production and is measured in business outcomes - and turns that field work into reusable product.

benchmarks.title: Discovery
benchmarks.detail: 20 documented discovery interviews and a problem brief the customer signs off without changing the problem statement.

benchmarks.title: Timed integration
benchmarks.detail: Given an unfamiliar API, a messy CSV and a legacy database, you ship a working, tested integration in four hours.

benchmarks.title: Unfamiliar codebase
benchmarks.detail: A meaningful change merged into an unfamiliar open-source project within one week of first opening it.

benchmarks.title: Real deployments
benchmarks.detail: Three deployments for real organisations reach production, each with outcome metrics and a written handover; two written references.

benchmarks.title: Defended out loud
benchmarks.detail: Defend a deployment for 30 minutes to a mixed panel: one engineer, one non-technical stakeholder.

stages.title: The FDE role and the deployment lifecycle
stages.goal: Understand what FDEs actually do, and why most deployments fail.
stages.doneWhen: You map the full deployment lifecycle for one real organisation and name the three places it is most likely to fail.
stages.resources: Bloomberry analysis of 1,000 FDE jobs  |  public FDE job descriptions from AI companies  |  S&P Global and Gartner reports on AI project failure
